rationale: S-0009-01 proposes inverse-fitting three-bin dendritic radii against the Schachter 2010 proximal/distal input-resistance gradient. Deeper morphology calibration is RQ2 work; the from-scratch wave currently uses the t0009 calibrated morphology and the immediate strategic question (escape the binary single-spike / full-suppression regime) sits on AMPA / GABA conductance and inhibition timing rather than morphology refinement. Reprioritising from high to medium until a working multi-spike substrate exists and morphology sensitivity becomes the active focus.
